examples: Eating fruit helps you stay healthy.
My puppy is healthy and strong.
Carrots are a healthy snack.

more.def: Having a strong body and mind; not ill. Also, good for your body.
examples: Exercise and sleep help keep you healthy.
The doctor said my teeth are healthy.
A healthy breakfast gives you energy for the morning.
This box of books is heavy.
The rock is too heavy to lift.
An elephant is very heavy.

more.def: Weighing a lot; hard to lift or move.
examples: The heavy backpack made his shoulders ache.
The truck carried a heavy load of bricks.
This winter coat is thick and heavy.

easy.def: A brave person who helps others.
examples: The firefighter is a hero.
My mom is my hero.
The hero in the story saves the town.

more.def: A person admired for being brave or for doing something great.
examples: She became a hero when she saved the child from the river.
The dog was called a hero for waking the family during the fire.
My hero is the scientist who found the cure.

easy.def: To stop for a moment because you are not sure.
examples: I hesitate before I jump in the pool.
The cat hesitated at the door.
Do not hesitate to ask for help.

more.def: To pause before doing something because you feel unsure or nervous.
examples: He hesitated at the door, wondering if he should knock.
She hesitated before answering the hard question.
The deer hesitated at the edge of the road.
